batchRequest.request: Add a phone number field and make the plan select default to the free plan.

patchOf:
root = Stack([title, form])
title = TextContent("Create your account", "large-heavy")
form = Form("signup", btns, [nameField, emailField, passwordField, planField, termsField])
nameField = FormControl("Name", Input("name", "Your full name", "text", {required: true, minLength: 2}))
emailField = FormControl("Email", Input("email", "you@example.com", "email", {required: true, email: true}))
passwordField = FormControl("Password", Input("password", "At least 8 characters", "password", {required: true, minLength: 8, pattern: "^(?=.*[A-Za-z])(?=.*\\d).+$"}), "Must include a letter and a number")
planField = FormControl("Plan", Select("plan", planOpts, "Choose a plan", {required: true}))
planOpts = [SelectItem("free", "Free"), SelectItem("pro", "Pro — $12/mo"), SelectItem("team", "Team — $36/mo")]
termsField = FormControl("Terms", CheckBoxGroup("terms", [termsItem], {required: true}))
termsItem = CheckBoxItem("I agree to the Terms of Service", "You must accept the terms to create an account", "accepted", false)
btns = Buttons([Button("Create account", @ToAssistant("Create my account"), "primary"), Button("Cancel", @ToAssistant("Cancel sign-up"), "secondary")])
request: Add a phone number field and make the plan select default to the free plan.
